title: Closing remarks
summary: Steiner ends the tape with comments on interview length.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: I think we've covered a pretty good segment of your, uh, experience and your attitude toward music and we've come to the end of the tape. Good. We don't have to strain you any further. You see, it really isn't an easy job to run for an hour and you can imagine the problems that some of these interviewers have had when they've interviewed people for days at a time. Sometimes it's possible. I haven't had an experience myself because an hour is a good long run.
